title: Plans as top-level documents with Tasks linked to stories
reference: Trevor's product direction, 2026-11-02: a Plan is its own kind of document, in a section beside Documentation and Reviews, not part of a feature. It has a phase-organized deck, prototypes, and Tasks with mapped dependencies, and every Task leads to a user story, directly or through the Tasks it unblocks. Comparing a Plan with its Reviews is the key value.
